abstract.t:
This document specifies procedures for variations of the "Bootstrapping Remote Secure Key Infrastructure" (BRSKI) architecture of protocols to automatically announce, discover, and select responders using different discovery mechanisms such as DNS-SD, GRASP, or CORE-LF. Different variations are not interoperable, so initiators need to be able to find responders that support the variation(s) they support. Procedures are defined for BRSKI proxies that allow proxying of traffic for any current or future variation. Procedures to discover BRSKI Pledges by their identifier are defined. Extensibility is provided through a set of IANA registries.
This document updates I-D.ietf-anima-brski-prm, RFC 6690, and RFC 9733.
